```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Clean global environment
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r kill_running_rserve_instance}
# Find and terminate any process listening on port 6311
port <- 6311
pids <- system(sprintf("lsof -ti tcp:%d", port), intern = TRUE, ignore.stderr = TRUE)
if (length(pids) > 0) {
  message("Killing process(es) using port ", port, ": ",  paste(pids, collapse = ", "))
  system2("kill", pids)
  Sys.sleep(1)
}
```

```{r load_metaboanalystr}
# Load the MetaboAnalystR package
library(MetaboAnalystR)
packageVersion("MetaboAnalystR")

# Load the missing volcano plotting helper function
volcano_url <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xia-lab/MetaboAnalystR/",
  "f32af5d5a90532f69474208b17b2db6e40a8f3da/R/util_volcano.R"
)
volcano_script <- "util_volcano.R"
download.file(volcano_url, destfile = volcano_script, mode = "wb")
source(volcano_script)

```

```{r init_mset_object}
# Initializes the mSet data
mSet <- InitDataObjects("conc", "stat", FALSE)
```

```{r load_the_data_set}
data_path <- '/mnt/teaching/bioinformatics/metaboanalyst/human_cachexia.csv'
mSet <- Read.TextData(mSet, data_path, format = "rowu", lbl.type = "disc")
str(mSet)
```

```{r perform_sanity_checks}
# Confirm that the data were loaded and check for missing values
mSet <- SanityCheckData(mSet)
mSet <- MetaboAnalystR:::PerformSanityClosure(mSet)
```

```{r check_groups}
# Examine the group assignments
table(mSet$dataSet$cls)
```

```{r normalize}
# Normalize data
mSet <- PreparePrenormData(mSet)
mSet <- Normalization(mSet, "NULL", "LogNorm", "MeanCenter", "S10T0", ratio=FALSE, ratioNum=20)

# Examine the dimensions of the imported dataset
dim(mSet$dataSet$norm)
```

```{r generated_normalization_plots}
mSet <- PlotNormSummary(mSet, "norm_0_", format ="png", dpi=72, width=NA)
mSet <- PlotSampleNormSummary(mSet, "snorm_0_", format = "png", dpi=72, width=NA)
```

```{r plot_normalized_data, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics(c("norm_0_dpi72.png", "snorm_0_dpi72.png"))
```

```{r analyze_fold_changes}
# Perform fold-change analysis on uploaded data, unpaired 
mSet <- FC.Anal(mSet, fc.thresh = 2.0, cmp.type = 0, paired = FALSE)

# Inspect log2 fold changes
head(sort(mSet$analSet$fc$fc.log))
```

```{r generate_t_test_table}
# Extract t-test results
tt <- mSet$analSet$tt

tt_results <- data.frame(
  Metabolite = names(tt$p.value),
  t_statistic = as.numeric(tt$t.score),
  p_value = as.numeric(tt$p.value),
  FDR = as.numeric(tt$fdr.p),
  Significant = as.logical(tt$inx.imp)
)

# Add log2 fold change
tt_results$log2FC <- mSet$analSet$fc$fc.log[match(tt_results$Metabolite, names(mSet$analSet$fc$fc.log))]

# Display the combined table
tt_results <- tt_results[order(tt_results$FDR), c("Metabolite", "log2FC", "t_statistic", "p_value", "FDR", "Significant")]

# Display a formatted table in R Markdown
knitr::kable(tt_results, digits = 4,caption = "Differential metabolite analysis")
```

```{r generate_fold_change_plot}
# Plot fold-change analysis
mSet <- PlotFC(mSet, "fc_0_", "png", 72, width=NA)
```

```{r plot_fold_changes, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics(c("fc_0_dpi72.png"))
```

```{r perform_volcano_analysis}
# Perform the volcano analysis
mSet <- Volcano.Anal( mSet, paired = FALSE, fcthresh = 2.0, cmpType=0, nonpar=FALSE, threshp = 0.05, equal.var=TRUE, pval.type="fdr")
```

```{r generage_vocano_plot}
# Create the volcano plot
mSet <- PlotVolcano(mSet, "volcano_0_", 1, 0, format="png", dpi=72, width=NA)
```

```{r volcano_plot, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics(c("volcano_0_dpi72.png"))
```

```{r}
# Correlation Analysis: Heatmap specifying pearson distance and an overview
mSet <- PlotCorrHeatMap(
  mSetObj = mSet,        # Updated parameter name
  imgName = "corr_0_",
  format  = "png",
  dpi     = 72,
  width   = NA,
  target  = "col",
  cor.method = "pearson", # Updated parameter name
  colors  = "bwm",
  fix.col = FALSE,       
  no.clst = FALSE,        # Controls whether to skip clustering (TRUE/FALSE)
  corrCutoff = 0.0,        # Replaces rep.thr for filtering weak correlations
  fz = 3,
  unit = 3
)
```

```{r plot_correlation_heatmap, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics(c("rpt_corr_heatmap.png"))
```
```{r pca}
# Perform PCA analysis
mSet <- PCA.Anal(mSet)
```

```{r generate_pca_plots}
# Create PCA scree plot
mSet <- PlotPCAScree(mSet, "pca_scree_0_", "png", dpi = 72, width=NA, 5)

# Create a 2D PCA score plot
mSet <- PlotPCA2DScore(mSet, "pca_score2d_0_", format = "png", dpi=72, width=NA, 1, 2, 0.95, 1, 0)

# Create a PCA loadings Plots
mSet <- PlotPCALoading(mSet, "pca_loading_0_", "png", 72, width=NA, 1,2)

# Create a PCA Biplot
mSet <- PlotPCABiplot(mSet, "pca_biplot_0_", format = "png", dpi = 72, width=NA, 1, 2)
```

```{r pca_plots, echo=FALSE, fig.align='center', out.width='90%'}
knitr::include_graphics(c("pca_scree_0_dpi72.png", "pca_score2d_0_dpi72.png", "pca_loading_0_dpi72.png", "pca_biplot_0_dpi72.png"))
```
